space.$description: Spacing. Tailwind's spacing unit: every spacing utility is a multiple of it.

unit.$description: Tailwind --spacing: p-4 = 4 × unit. Chosen by Brian on 2026-11-25: Spacing → Compact.

touch-target.$description: Minimum touch target in both dimensions for every interactive element (ui-components spec). Utilities: size-touch, min-h-touch, min-w-touch.
